For more information and to order stereo imagery products, please refer to the GEO Stereo Imagery Order Form.

  • Time of Capture: April 26th to May 7th, 2013
  • Number of Images: 319 lines 
  • Resolution: 18 centimetre (RGBN)
  • Bit-depth: 16-bit 
  • Number of bands: Four band (RGBN) 
  • Format: TIFF (SocetSet model setup) 
  • Camera(s): Leica ADS80 line based
The acquisition area spans two Universal Transverse Mercator (UTM) Zones of UTM Zone 17 and UTM Zone 18.  View the acquisition area for each zone by clicking the links near the bottom of this record.  A new page opens and you may need to zoom in to see the individual one kilometre squared tiles.  To download the index, click the ‘View Full Details’ button and finally the ‘Download’ button near the top of the page that opens. Alternatively, you can click HERE to bring the map up in an ArcGIS online map viewer. 
 

 

For more information on the South Central Ontario Orthophotography Project (SCOOP) 2013 please see the main SCOOP 2013 GeoHub record. 

 
Available Products: 
Stereo Frames 
  • South Central Ontario Orthophotography Project (SCOOP) 2013 - Stereo Frames and associated AT Models 

Contact Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources - Geospatial Ontario, geospatial@ontario.ca
